title: Connect your tools
description: Integrations turn Linear into your source of truth around product development. Keep data in sync, and eliminate manual updates between tools.Key integrationsSlack​Create issues from Slack messages and sync threadsGitHub / GitLab​Automate your pull request, commit workflows, and keep issues synced both waysAgents​Deploy AI agents that work alongside you as teammatesBrowse all integrationsDiscover 150+ available connections in our integration directory – from bug creation via support tools (Intercom, Zendesk), to issues created from design explorations (Figma).Linear APIIf you need something more custom, you can build directly on the Linear API (built on GraphQL).
